code:
$ dig northbridgeretail.com A

;; ANSWER SECTION:
northbridgeretail.com.   3600  IN  A     203.0.113.42

$ dig checkout.northbridgeretail.com CNAME

;; ANSWER SECTION:
checkout.northbridgeretail.com. 60 IN CNAME northbridgeretail.com.
caption: The 3600 and 60 are each record's TTL, in seconds — how long a resolver may cache that answer.
